name: Iva Marell
source_profile:
Iva Marell (NG) — Keeper of the Open Table

Sister Iva is a middle-aged healer who operates Redvale's small charitable infirmary. She arrived among the refugees fleeing the aftermath of the War of Broken Banners and has since devoted herself to assisting the town's poor and displaced.

She is well regarded among the residents of the Dry End, although her willingness to treat wounded outlaws and members of the Wilderfolk has occasionally attracted criticism from the authorities.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 103 (source excerpt; may be partial)
